note: Furniture for the habitat main room. Positions are in the habitat's own three.js space (x toward the airlock, y up, z sideways), metres; add each model as a child of the habitat. 'blocks' is the floor circle (or a list of circles, for wide pieces) a walker cannot enter (habitat space x / v, same convention as walk_zones in habitat.json). Optional 'scale' is a uniform scale for that copy. Meshes whose name contains 'glass' are see-through panes (give them a transparent glass material).

planning_table.what: round map table at standing height: lit rim ring, three small edge consoles with buttons, strutted pedestal. The flat top (radius 0.54 m, 0.96 m above the floor) is where the Plan-mode map is drawn

suit_rack.what: wall rack with two helmets, hanger bars and a boot tray (1.94 m tall, clears the ceiling)

sample_glovebox.what: sealed sample cabinet where the sample case is delivered: base cupboard, worktop, lit chamber with glove ports and black gloves reaching in, sloped window, sample tubes, rock chips and a scale inside, small pass-through hatch with hand wheel on the right, filters and gauges on top. Two meshes: 'sample_glovebox' and 'sample_glovebox_glass' (the window pane, see-through)

stool.made_by: Poly Haven 'Metal Stool 02' (CC0), reduced to 2.2k triangles, 512 px colour texture only

shelves.made_by: Poly Haven 'Steel Frame Shelves 01' (CC0), reduced to 2.2k triangles, 512 px colour texture only

crate.made_by: Poly Haven 'Plastic Crate 02' (CC0), reduced to 2.2k triangles, 512 px colour texture only

sample_canister.what: sealed sample canister with carry handle, 0.45 m tall - a loose piece a player could pick up

tablet.what: hand tablet lying flat, screen glows (vertex alpha 0.2)

free_floor: the stools are tucked under the table rim, so a ring about 0.45 m wide (walker centre between 0.95 m and 1.4 m from the middle) stays free all the way round: one astronaut walks it, a second can follow or wait in the airlock. Checked in Blender: no piece touches another piece or the fixed wall equipment (screens, the shelves under them, ceiling conduit).
